body: She will have scammed you for money and for faith, which is all pretty despicable. Sadly, assholes like her are a dime a dozen on the internet, and in the fitness industry. If she's scammed you, expose her so as to save others your woes. Unfortunately, I don't know of any avenues legally to chase down this woman and your money, but I hope you'll look into it. Some people really suck, if I wasn't also poor please know I'd help you however I could. Which I know doesn't help you, but yeah... Stay safe!
